description: Get the details of a server, for a given service, that are onboarded to Azure Active Directory Connect Health Service.

operations.description: Gets the details of a server, for a given service, that are onboarded to Azure Active Directory Connect Health Service.

consts.description: The version of the API to be used with the client request.
consts.name: api-version

props.description: The total number of alerts that are currently active for the server.
props.name: activeAlerts

props.description: The additional information, if any, for the server.
props.name: additionalInformation

props.description: The date time , in UTC, when the server was onboarded to Azure Active Directory Connect Health.
props.name: createdDate

props.description: The server specific configuration related dimensions.
props.name: dimensions

props.description: Indicates if the server is disabled or not.
props.name: disabled

props.description: The reason for disabling the server.
props.name: disabledReason

props.description: The list of installed QFEs for the server.
props.name: installedQfes

props.description: The date and time , in UTC, when the server was last disabled.
props.name: lastDisabled

props.description: The date and time, in UTC, when the server was last rebooted.
props.name: lastReboot

props.description: The date and time, in UTC, when the server's data monitoring configuration was last changed.
props.name: lastServerReportedMonitoringLevelChange

props.description: The date and time, in UTC, when the server properties were last updated.
props.name: lastUpdated

props.description: The id of the machine.
props.name: machineId

props.description: The name of the server.
props.name: machineName

props.description: The monitoring configuration of the server which determines what activities are monitored by Azure Active Directory Connect Health.
props.name: monitoringConfigurationsComputed

props.description: The customized monitoring configuration of the server which determines what activities are monitored by Azure Active Directory Connect Health.
props.name: monitoringConfigurationsCustomized

props.description: The name of the operating system installed in the machine.
props.name: osName

props.description: The version of the operating system installed in the machine.
props.name: osVersion

props.description: Server specific properties.
props.name: properties

props.description: The list of recommended hotfixes for the server.
props.name: recommendedQfes

props.description: The total count of alerts that are resolved for this server.
props.name: resolvedAlerts

props.description: The service role that is being monitored in the server.
props.name: role

props.description: The monitoring level reported by the server.
props.name: serverReportedMonitoringLevel

props.description: The service id to whom this server belongs.
props.name: serviceId

props.description: The id of the server.
props.name: serviceMemberId

props.description: The health status of the server.
props.name: status

props.description: The tenant id to whom this server belongs.
props.name: tenantId
